raw_description:
Position Type: Part-time (20 hours per week), with the potential to transition to full-time as the client portfolio and workload grow

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 11AM - 3PM US EST

Salary Range: 55,000 - 65,000 Php

About the Company

Our client is a leading eCommerce software company that empowers Amazon Brands and Agencies with data-driven tools for business growth. Their all-in-one toolset enables product research, listing optimization, sales tracking, and overall success on the Amazon platform.

Working with our client involves managing Amazon-related tasks, project coordination, and workflows to ensure seamless execution. They foster a forward-thinking, adaptable, and collaborative environment, committed to supporting their team and clients in achieving their goals.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a Senior Amazon PPC Lead to help shape and strengthen the agency's PPC strategy while managing assigned client accounts. This part-time role combines strategic leadership with hands-on account management, including campaign optimization, automation, budgeting, and performance analysis.

The successful candidate will collaborate with the existing PPC Manager, Account Leads, and Project Managers, occasionally joining client calls to present strategy and recommendations. They will also provide account coverage during absences and high-demand periods, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time role as the agency expands its client portfolio.

This is a 100% remote position.

Responsibilities

- PPC Strategy & Oversight: Guide strategy, targets, budgets, and product priorities across multiple client accounts.
- Coaching & Support: Hold twice-weekly check-ins with the PPC Manager and provide guidance on complex projects.
- Performance Optimization: Review campaign performance and recommend improvements across bids, budgets, targeting, and profitability.
- Automation Management: Advise on the setup and refinement of client-specific bidding rules within the PPC automation platform.
- Team & Client Collaboration: Work with Account Leads, Project Managers, and clients to align PPC initiatives with business goals.
- Account Coverage: Step in to manage and optimize accounts during the primary PPC Manager's absence.

Competencies and Qualifications

Must-Have

- Extensive experience managing Amazon PPC across multiple client accounts.
- Advanced knowledge of campaign strategy, optimization, budget management, and profitability metrics.
- Hands-on experience with Amazon PPC automation and bid-management tools, preferably PPC Butler.
- Proven client-facing experience presenting PPC performance, insights, and recommendations.
- Strong understanding of how PPC supports broader Amazon marketing, organic growth, and commercial objectives.

Nice-to-Have

- Amazon agency or multi-client portfolio experience.
- Experience managing high-spend or high-revenue accounts

WHAT WE OFFER

- 100% Remote Work - Work from anywhere in the Philippines.
- Career Growth Opportunities - Gain hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning.
- Collaborative & Innovative Team - Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

APPLICATION PROCESS

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we're here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview and Client Interviews. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.
